jobs.title: Principal Visual Designer
jobs.desc: About us You've probably heard of Autotrader, but do you know what we're all about? We're the most trusted, most visited automotive marketplace in the UK. A heritage brand and a tech innovator. We bring together vehicle buyers and sellers to give them real choices. We go our own way while embracing diversity and celebrating our differences. We dedicate ourselves to the idea that we work better together.  Autotrader is a beautiful, surprising and vibrant place to work. We might not be for everyone, but we could be perfect for you.  About the job Help shape the next chapter of Autotrader's in-house creative studio. We're moving from a production-led team to an in-house creative agency, with the ambition to stand alongside the best in-house teams in the industry. As a Principal Visual Designer, you'll play a hands-on role in shaping and delivering high-quality visual design to achieve that ambition. You’ll help define the visual direction for complex, multi-channel work, creating exceptional design across digital, print, brand and campaign activity, while ensuring our creative output is consistent, accessible and aligned to Autotrader’s brand standards. Alongside producing high-quality design work yourself, you’ll lead, coach and develop visual designers, helping them grow their craft, build confidence and understand how their work connects to Autotrader’s goals. You’ll set clear expectations around quality, ways of working, and delivery, while creating an inclusive and supportive environment where people can do their best work. What we're looking for A strong portfolio showing excellent visual craft and technically well-executed work, with context about the brief, your contribution and the decisions behind it. Strong hands-on design capability and a deep understanding of design principles, typography, layout, colour and accessibility Experience leading and coaching designers, with a genuine motivation to help people grow and develop Experience developing design standards, design systems, creative processes to improve consistency and efficiency Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills  Extensive experience translating complex briefs into clear, effective solutions  Able to balance hands-on delivery with people leadership, project priorities and longer-term improvements to design capability  Experience identifying and implementing emerging design trends, creative technology and automation  During our application process, you will be asked two questions to help us learn more about you and how you align with our values.  Please include a link to your portfolio, with case studies that help us understand the work rather than visuals alone. During these periods, you can work remotely anywhere in the UK and from certain locations abroad. Alongside a wide range of benefits, we'll help you settle in with confidence from day one. If you're successful, one of the first things you'll experience is our tailored  new-starter induction programme,  Great Start, designed to help you feel welcome, connected,  and set up for success. #LI-AJ1 #LI-Hybrid

It puts AI to work on the decisions that matter most to large organisations, such as where to invest, how to allocate resources, and when to act. Every enterprise is investing heavily in AI, but few are confident it will improve performance. Too often it goes to what’s easy to automate, disconnected from the decisions that actually move the business. Frontier works backwards from objectives like revenue, margin and risk to the decisions that drive them, then connects the data, models and agents those decisions need into a world model of the business. We believe in AI that helps people think, with humans and agents working together inside a decision system. Customers start with one high-value decision and prove value in weeks. Frontier is built by Faculty, an AI company that has delivered more than 400 systems since 2014 and is now part of Accenture. jobs.desc: Who we are: We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay. We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers. Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us? About the role. As a Senior Product Designer at Zilch, you will be accountable for every feature you design - from the very first sketch through to implementation, you'll guide all stages of the design process and ensure they are of the highest quality. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, and other Designers, to deliver exceptional user experiences that align with our vision and goals. You’ll not only do world class design work, but also help the rest of the team do great design work too. Day-to-day responsibilities. - Take responsibility for the full design process from collaborative research, conception, testing, full journey specs and developer collaboration, through to UX measurement of the launched product. - Coach and mentor your fellow designers, leading critique sessions to help develop a consistently strong holistic experience. - Nurture consistency across different pieces of design work and strengthen the bar we set for the quality of our collective output. - Design customer journeys, create prototypes, user test and measure the success of potential product launches. - Help define and deliver products that are enjoyable to use with a high level of craft and attention to detail. - Work collaboratively to manage and improve our scalable design system that meets product and business goals. - Carry out user research through a range of qualitative and quantitative methods to understand the user experience. - Identify key success metrics of the products you’re on and measure their success from a customer and business perspective. - You’ll work closely with our Head of Product Design and Product Managers to align on goals, priorities, direction, and feedback. - Document pattern libraries and style guides, updating as we evolve. - Review the performance of the release, identify learnings, and suggest ways to shape the future product. What we’re looking for... - Demonstrated experience working in a cross functional team, designing consumer facing products. - You enjoy thinking through complex product challenges and care about solving the right problem. - You have a well-trained eye for exceptional visual design/UI execution. You care about getting things right - one pixel off is a big deal. - Think strategically about product and design at every level, communicating decisions with clarity and confidence and producing work built to last - Are well versed at working with disciplines in your work to achieve the best outcome, such as user research, content, and engineering. - Are a fantastic storyteller, communicating your thinking and design decisions in a way that brings stakeholders along on the journey with you - Experience using and helping to maintain a design system. - Proven experience advocating for users and applying learnings from research into your design. - Ability to analyse product experiments. - Be an advocate for design, with an understanding and ability to articulate how it helps reach business goals. - You are someone that likes to experiment with new ways of working and AI tools to optimise your design process.
